thread:
Elena (CS): Hey team — we need to lock down enablement sessions for @StellarApps next week. They want 3 things: onboarding checklist walkthrough, API integration deep-dive, and renewal health review. Who can own each block? :spiral_calendar:

Jonah (Solutions): I can run the integration deep-dive. Prefer Tue or Wed morning (PST). Suggest 90m with live pairing.

Priya (Onboarding): I'll take the onboarding checklist + config review. 45m should be enough. Tue afternoon or Thu works for me.

Tom (Account Exec): FYI renewal flagged low engagement in Q2. Can we add a focused 30m "renewal health" checkpoint + success metrics? Prefer Fri so execs can join.

Marcus (Eng Onboarding): Happy to co-run the API pairing session. Need to prep a small sample app and Postman collection. Can demo telemetry + retries.

Elena (CS): Nice. Proposed plan:
- Tue 10:00 PST — Onboarding checklist (Priya, 45m)
- Wed 09:30 PST — API deep-dive (Jonah + Marcus, 90m)
- Fri 11:00 PST — Renewal health + Q&A (Tom + Elena, 30m)

Elena (CS): Can everyone react with :thumbsup: on the slot they prefer, or reply if conflicts. If we get conflicts we'll offer alternate slots.

Jonah (Solutions): :thumbsup: for Wed 09:30

Priya (Onboarding): small conflict Tue 10:00 — can do Tue 15:00 instead.

Marcus (Eng Onboarding): Wed 09:30 works. I'll put the pairing repo link in the doc and add a quick setup note.

Tom (Account Exec): Fri 11:00 ok for me but can push to 12:00 if execs need lunch buffer.

Elena (CS): Cool. I'll update the schedule to reflect Priya at Tue 15:00 and keep Wed 09:30 + Fri 11:00 tentative.

Elena (CS): Agenda doc (draft): https://docs.redwood/example/steller-enablement-draft — please add 3-5 bullets per session and any prework.

Priya (Onboarding): Added prework: invite to share current config, SSO details, and a short list of pain points (1-2 bullets).

Jonah (Solutions): I'll add the repo + Postman collection link and a troubleshooting checklist.

meeting-scheduler-bot: Created calendar holds for the proposed slots. Invites will send once Elena confirms final times.

Elena (CS): Final ask — Tom, can you confirm exec attendance for the Fri slot by EOD tomorrow? Then I'll send final invites and a short customer-facing prep email.

Tom (Account Exec): Will check and confirm by EOD. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:

Elena (CS): Thanks — once confirmed I'll post the invite and a short prep note to the customer and add the sessions to our renewals tracker.

Marcus (Eng Onboarding): Quick note: for the API deep-dive please ask StellarApps to have a dev token ready — speeds pairing.

Elena (CS): Noted. I'll add that to the prep email.

Tom (Account Exec): Confirmed execs can do Fri 11:00. Please go ahead and send invites.

Elena (CS): Sending invites now and copying the prep doc. Closing thread after invites go out. :white_check_mark:
